answer: Model the agent economy as a trust graph and track its Laplacian spectrum. Honest peers form a dense grove of cross-links that mixes fast, giving a large spectral gap; a sybil swarm joined by only a few bribed edges localizes energy in a low eigenvector like a flaw in jade, a clear bottleneck signal. The network continuously recomputes the second eigenvalue and quarantines any cluster whose mixing time spikes, so padding fake identities only deepens their own detectable isolation and earns no added weight.
